scope.head: 103cadb60833bbfc5f20086ae14c93cab25b8ede

composition.role: introduces the correlated ChatDeltaSubscription contract and runtime suppression of incomplete callback/identity pairs
adds backend-specific api-discriminant request narrowing and typed rejection for a wrong request arm
repairs both hosted-backend test helpers so overrides preserve ChatDeltaSubscription instead of flattening the correlated pair with Partial

scope.ancestry: git merge-base --is-ancestor returned 0 for all three commits against HEAD

summary: The present tree satisfies issue #2538. A delta callback cannot be expressed without a real ChatId through the typed ChatRequest contract; all three emitting backends suppress an incomplete runtime pair; no empty ChatId fabrication remains in inference; hosted backend dispatch narrows by the api discriminant and rejects mismatches; and ordinary callback-free requests still execute. The later helper repair in 727a1b001 makes the current native TypeScript program clean.

type_boundary.evidence: ChatDeltaSubscription is `{ chatId: ChatId; onDelta: callback } | { chatId?: ChatId; onDelta?: undefined }`, and ChatRequestCommon intersects that union into every ChatRequest arm.
type_boundary.type_test: tests/inference/contract/chat.test-d.ts accepts the paired callback and callback-free arm, and rejects both callback-without-chatId and callback-with-explicit-undefined-chatId.

runtime_backstops: packages/inference/src/backends/agent-sdk/runner.ts:845 destructures chatId/onDelta and returns before emission if either is undefined.
packages/inference/src/backends/anthropic-messages/chat.ts:256 creates deltaTarget only when both fields exist; both text and reasoning emission use that target.
packages/inference/src/backends/openai-compat/chat.ts:407 applies the same paired target check for both delta kinds.
contract_and_runtime.runtime_malformed_pair: The conformance test deletes chatId through Reflect while retaining onDelta. OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages, and Agent SDK all returned the truthful completed reply and delivered no fabricated delta callback.
contract_and_runtime.fabricated_identity_sweep: Structural and literal sweeps found no inference castId<ChatId> or `as ChatId` fabrication in packages/inference or tests/inference. The parent of 0e961ef63 had exactly three castId<ChatId>(... ?? empty-string) sites; HEAD has zero.
backend_narrowing: packages/inference/src/backends/anthropic-messages/index.ts:32 narrows ChatRequest to AnthropicChatRequest with req.api === anthropic-messages; runChatTurn rejects a mismatch with ProviderError before calling the specific backend.

packages/inference/src/backends/openai-compat/index.ts:27 narrows ChatRequest to OpenAiCompatChatRequest with req.api === chat-completions; runChatTurn rejects a mismatch with ProviderError before calling the specific backend.
contract_and_runtime.chatless_no_delta: Both hosted backend suites use a default request with neither chatId nor onDelta and pass all 33 backend tests. The callback-free union arm also permits an optional chatId for session lineage without enabling delivery.

helper_repair.anthropic: tests/inference/backends/anthropic-messages/chat.test.ts:53 defines Partial<Omit<AnthropicChatRequest, chatId | onDelta>> & ChatDeltaSubscription and checks the base with satisfies AnthropicChatRequest.
helper_repair.openai: tests/inference/backends/openai-compat/chat.test.ts:43 defines Partial<Omit<OpenAiCompatChatRequest, chatId | onDelta>> & ChatDeltaSubscription and checks the base with satisfies OpenAiCompatChatRequest.
helper_repair.effect: Override helpers can no longer manufacture an optional callback independently of identity, and the root native program accepts them.

structural_sweep.tool: pnpm exec ast-grep with TypeScript and TSX languages, corroborated with rg
results: TypeScript `$OBJ?.onDelta` scan: 4 matches, the two text/reasoning sites in each hosted backend.
TypeScript `onDelta($$$ARGS)` scan: 2 matches, the agent-sdk text/reasoning emissions.
TSX member scan: 0 matches; a TSX identifier positive control matched tests/support/browser/ct-providers.tsx, so the zero was not a parser/tool failure.
rg over TS and TSX corroborated the inference producers and server compose/engine consumers; no additional delta producer was hidden in TSX.

focused_runtime.result: success true; 4/4 suites passed; 43 passed, 3 expected local-light-unserved skips, 0 failed
observed_cases: All three served chat wires passed the malformed callback-without-ChatId suppression case.
All three served chat wires passed the positive stream case where the observed deltas equal the committed reply.
All three served chat wires passed the truncated-stream fail-closed case.
Anthropic hosted backend: 16 passed; OpenAI-compatible hosted backend: 17 passed.

verification.target_cleanliness: git diff --name-only over the inference contract, three backends, focused backend/conformance/type tests returned no paths; the reviewed implementation and helper repair are committed.

exact_range_receipt.reason: At exact commit 2c57f1808, before 727a1b001, the two hosted-backend test helpers used Partial<BackendChatRequest>. Native root typecheck produced TS2322 at tests/inference/backends/anthropic-messages/chat.test.ts:71 and tests/inference/backends/openai-compat/chat.test.ts:59 because the flattened helper could express onDelta without required chatId.
exact_range_receipt.relationship_to_current_verdict: That exact-range verdict remains valid. Commit 727a1b001 is outside the original two-commit range and is the committed repair that changes the current-tree verdict to CONFIRMED.

limitations: The worktree contains unrelated concurrent modifications and untracked audit/plugin/chat-persistence work. One modified consumer file is packages/server/src/domain/chat/engine/engine.ts. The reviewed inference target files are clean, the focused inference suites passed on the actual current worktree, and both inference/server plus root native type programs passed with the concurrent state present.
The three local-light conformance cases were skipped as explicitly unserved; the same contract/backstop behavior was exercised and passed on all three served delta-producing wires.
